label.purpose: Table heads, eyebrows, tile labels, fact keys.

tile-number.purpose: A count on a home tile, scaled to the tile.

components.name: Tile
components.description: A count on the home page, its group's colour on a top rule.
components.css: .ds-tile { --c: var(--s1, #3987e5); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; width: 150px; border: 1px solid var(--hair, #2a2a27); border-top: 3px solid var(--c); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #141413); color: var(--ink, #f0efec); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tile:hover, .ds-tile:focus-visible { border-color: var(--c); outline: none; } .ds-tile span { font: 500 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #8a8880); } .ds-tile b { font: 600 22px/1.2 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tile small { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 4px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 11px/1.5 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--ink-2, #b9b7ad); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A grouping or filter; pressed is lime.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">no grouping</button> <button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">dataset</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 500 12px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--hair, #2a2a27); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #141413); color: var(--muted, #8a8880); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { color: var(--ink, #f0efec); border-color: var(--accent, #c8ff3d); outline: none; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--accent-ink, #0b0b0a); background: var(--accent, #c8ff3d); border-color: var(--accent, #c8ff3d); }

components.name: Action
components.description: A compact action that sits in a table row, tinted with the accent.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--ink, #f0efec); text-decoration: none; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c8ff3d) 12%, var(--surface, #141413)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c8ff3d) 38%, var(--hair, #2a2a27)); transition: background .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-action::after { content: '→'; color: var(--accent, #c8ff3d); } .ds-action:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c8ff3d) 24%, var(--surface, #141413)); border-color: var(--accent, #c8ff3d); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c8ff3d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reference Tier
components.description: A reference set's tier, in its own colour.
components.css: .ds-tier { display: inline-block; font: 700 11px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-gold { background: var(--gold-bg, #4a3a0c); color: var(--gold-ink, #f3d77a); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold-ink, #f3d77a) 35%, transparent); } .ds-silver { background: var(--silver-bg, #3a3d42); color: var(--silver-ink, #dde2e8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--silver-ink, #dde2e8) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Label Source
components.description: Who wrote a label set: an outlined tag in its own neutral colour.
components.html: person model rule
components.css: .ds-src { display: inline-block; font: 600 11px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The main surface: monospace heads, hairline rows, a second line where it helps.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; font: 15px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #f0efec); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font: 500 11px/1.3 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #8a8880); padding: 0 16px 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, #2a2a27); } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, #2a2a27); vertical-align: top; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table small { color: var(--muted, #8a8880); font-size: 12px; } .ds-id { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview:
The catalog is the site's lab notebook turned to its tables. The site states a finding; the catalog keeps every run behind it, in columns a person can sort, filter and check, and the inspector reopens any comparison item by item. It shares the site's foundation (near-black and warm paper, Highlighter Lime, a heavy grotesk over a calm sans, monospace for everything exact) and spends it on reading rather than on occasion: titles are smaller, tables are the main surface, and colour is wayfinding.

The voice is the same, confident and plain, at working density. A page opens with a short title and one sentence on what it holds, then tiles and tables. Tables are comfortable to read: a row has room for a second line (a model's provider, a rescore's change), and a long table shows ten rows at a time. Nothing on a page writes to the project: a decision it suggests is the command that makes it.

- The site's tokens, with muted text darkened to 4.5:1 on every surface and a visible lime focus ring. - Four group colours as wayfinding: goals violet, data blue, arms green, work and spend amber. - Sortable, filterable, paged tables as the main surface; on a phone each row becomes a card. - Reference tiers as pills in their own colours (gold, silver), never in the accent or the group colours. - Monospace for every id, number, label, chip and action.

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: A group colour says which part of the catalog something belongs to, never whether it is good: a trend is tinted in its group's colour whichever way it moves.

rules.name: The Tier Is Its Own Colour Rule
rules.body: Gold and silver belong to reference tiers only; a label set's source has a neutral colour of its own, never a tier's.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: As on the site: the accent marks what is current or selected, never a value.

dos: **Do** mark which part of the catalog something belongs to with its group colour, on a 3px rule or a chart line.
**Do** keep muted text at 4.5:1 or more and the lime focus ring on everything that takes focus.
**Do** show a suggested decision as the command that makes it.
**Do** keep tables comfortable: room for a second line, ten rows a page, filter and sort over every row.
donts: **Don't** use a group colour, the accent or a tier colour to say a value is good or bad.
**Don't** give a label set's source a tier's gold or silver.
**Don't** add a shadow to a tile, a table or a card.
**Don't** let a page write to the project.
